```{r}
peak_parts <- strsplit(pred_neurons$peak, "-")
pred_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = pred_neurons$chr,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = as.numeric(sapply(peak_parts, "[", 2)),
    end = as.numeric(sapply(peak_parts, "[", 3))
  ),
  gene = pred_neurons$gene,
  prob = pred_neurons$prob,
  original_idx = seq_len(nrow(pred_neurons))
)

overlaps <- findOverlaps(pred_gr, encode)
matching_genes <- pred_gr$gene[queryHits(overlaps)] == encode$gene[subjectHits(overlaps)]

# Get indices of true positives
true_positive_indices <- unique(queryHits(overlaps)[matching_genes])

# Create true labels (1 = in benchmark, 0 = not in benchmark)
pred_neurons[, true_label := 0]
pred_neurons[pred_gr$original_idx[true_positive_indices], true_label := 1]

# Print summary statistics
cat("Total predictions:", nrow(pred_neurons), "\n")
cat("True positives (in ENCODE):", sum(pred_neurons$true_label), "\n")
cat("True negatives (not in ENCODE):", sum(pred_neurons$true_label == 0), "\n")
cat("Positive rate:", round(mean(pred_neurons$true_label), 4), "\n\n")

pr_obj <- pr.curve(
  scores.class0 = pred_neurons[true_label == 1, prob],
  scores.class1 = pred_neurons[true_label == 0, prob],
  curve = TRUE
)

pr_curve_data <- pr_obj$curve

pr_df <- data.frame(
  recall = pr_curve_data[,1],
  precision = pr_curve_data[,2]
)

ggplot(pr_df, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline_precision, 
             linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = 0.5, 
           y = baseline_precision + 0.03,
           label = paste("Baseline:", round(baseline_precision, 4)),
           color = "red", size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Precision-Recall Curve",
       subtitle = paste("AUPRC =", round(pr_obj$auc.integral, 4),
                       "| Baseline =", round(baseline_precision, 4)),
       x = "Recall",
       y = "Precision") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))
```

# ENRICHMENT ANALYSIS
```{r}

pred_neurons_sorted <- pred_neurons[order(-prob)]
pred_neurons_sorted[, cumulative_tp := cumsum(true_label)]
pred_neurons_sorted[, rank := 1:.N]


total_positives <- sum(pred_neurons_sorted$true_label)
total_predictions <- nrow(pred_neurons_sorted)
positive_rate <- total_positives / total_predictions

pred_neurons_sorted[, expected_tp := rank * positive_rate]
pred_neurons_sorted[, enrichment := log2((1 + cumulative_tp) / (1 + expected_tp))]

library(ggplot2)

# Option 1: Plot against rank
p1 <- ggplot(pred_neurons_sorted, aes(x = rank, y = enrichment)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "darkblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Enrichment Plot",
       subtitle = paste("True positives:", total_positives, "out of", total_predictions),
       x = "Rank (sorted by prediction score)",
       y = "Log2 Fold Enrichment\nlog2((1+observed)/(1+expected))") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p1)

# Option 2: Plot against score
p2 <- ggplot(pred_neurons_sorted, aes(x = prob, y = enrichment)) +
  geom_line(size = 1, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Enrichment Plot by Score",
       subtitle = paste("True positives:", total_positives, "out of", total_predictions),
       x = "Prediction Score (high to low)",
       y = "Log2 Fold Enrichment\nlog2((1+observed)/(1+expected))") +
  scale_x_reverse() +  # Reverse x-axis so highest scores are on the left
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(p2)
```

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
process_and_plot_model <- function(pred_file, model_name, encode_data, color_choice) {
  pred <- fread(pred_file)
  peak_parts <- strsplit(pred$peak, "-")
  pred_gr <- GRanges(
    seqnames = pred$chr,
    ranges = IRanges(
      start = as.numeric(sapply(peak_parts, "[", 2)),
      end = as.numeric(sapply(peak_parts, "[", 3))
    ),
    gene = pred$gene,
    prob = pred$prob,
    original_idx = seq_len(nrow(pred))
  )
  
  overlaps <- findOverlaps(pred_gr, encode_data)
  matching_genes <- pred_gr$gene[queryHits(overlaps)] == encode_data$gene[subjectHits(overlaps)]
  true_positive_indices <- unique(queryHits(overlaps)[matching_genes])
  
  pred[, true_label := 0]
  pred[pred_gr$original_idx[true_positive_indices], true_label := 1]
  
  baseline_precision <- sum(pred$true_label) / nrow(pred)
  
  pr_obj <- pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = pred[true_label == 1, prob],
    scores.class1 = pred[true_label == 0, prob],
    curve = TRUE
  )
  
  pred_sorted <- pred[order(-prob)]
  pred_sorted[, rank := 1:.N]
  pred_sorted[, percent_rank := 100 * rank / .N]
  pred_sorted[, cumulative_tp := cumsum(true_label)]
  positive_rate <- sum(pred_sorted$true_label) / nrow(pred_sorted)
  pred_sorted[, expected_tp := rank * positive_rate]
  pred_sorted[, enrichment := log2((1 + cumulative_tp) / (1 + expected_tp))]
  
  list(
    model = model_name,
    color = color_choice,
    pr_data = data.frame(
      recall = pr_obj$curve[,1],
      precision = pr_obj$curve[,2],
      model = model_name
    ),
    enrichment_data = pred_sorted[, .(percent_rank, enrichment, model = model_name)],
    auprc = pr_obj$auc.integral,
    baseline = baseline_precision,
    n_tp = sum(pred$true_label),
    n_total = nrow(pred)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# 1) Load and keep only what's needed from the raw feature table
feat <- fread("/mnt/germain/work/tomohl/pgboost-project/output/xgBoost_outputs/data_noSNP.tsv")[
  , .(peak, gene, peak_gene_distance, celltype)
]

# 2) Deduplicate (in case the same peak–gene appears multiple times in the raw table)
#    If there are multiple distances per pair, take the median to be robust.
feat_agg <- feat[, .(peak_gene_distance = median(peak_gene_distance, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(peak, gene, celltype)]

# 3) Merge predictions with the (deduped) feature distances
test <- merge(pred_neurons_allParams_tuned, feat_agg, by = c("peak", "gene", "celltype"), all.x = TRUE)

# 4) Quick sanity checks
test[, dups := .N, by = .(peak, gene, celltype)]
message("Rows after merge: ", nrow(test))
message("Missing distances: ", sum(is.na(test$peak_gene_distance)))
message("Any duplicated peak–gene pairs post-merge? ", any(test$dups > 1))

# 5) Plot: probability vs distance (log-scaled distance helps)
ggplot(test[!is.na(peak_gene_distance)], aes(x = peak_gene_distance, y = prob)) +
  geom_hex(bins = 60) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", direction = -1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "white", size = 1.2) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Peak–gene distance (bp, log scale)",
    y = "Predicted probability",
    subtitle = "Density of predicted links by genomic distance"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
